bibl.title: Una mención a Tmuis en Elio Aristides (XXXVI 112-113 K).
bibl.seg: Amado Jesús de Miguel Zabala, Una mención a Tmuis en Elio Aristides (XXXVI 112-113 K).
bibl.note: Thmuis is mentioned by Aelius Aristides in a passage from The Egyptian Discourse as the polis of the Mendesian Nome. The text allows us to move forward towards the end of the first half of the 2nd century AD the capital change from Mendes to Thmuis.
